title: Decline of parade bass drummers
summary: Dejan agrees today's bass drummers are not as good as the earlier ones. He praises his current drummer, who learned from his father, and names earlier bass drummers.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
